summary: Catalyst Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $200 million in gross proceeds, plus a private placement of 270,000 units for $2.7 million. The company also reported a partial exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option, selling an additional 1,150,000 units for $11.5 million. Proceeds of $200 million were placed in a trust account. This is a SPAC IPO, a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
